Classic Tudor Charm with Room to Make It Your Own

A well-established 1962 Tudor-style home offering classic character, comfortable living space, and a convenient location.

Step inside and discover the timeless appeal of this nine-room Tudor-style home, featuring three bedrooms and two full bathrooms. A welcoming fireplace adds warmth and character to the living space, while the enclosed sun porch provides a versatile spot to relax, enjoy morning coffee, or take in the seasons.

Outside, the property offers a spacious front yard along with a large cement patio, creating plenty of room for outdoor entertaining, gardening, or simply enjoying the outdoors.

Additional features include a partial basement for storage and an attached garage for everyday convenience.

Located just minutes from major shopping, this property combines the appeal of a classic home with easy access to nearby amenities.

Property Highlights

• 1962 Tudor-style home
• Nine rooms
• 3 bedrooms
• 2 full bathrooms
• Fireplace
• Enclosed sun porch
• Attached garage
• Partial basement
• Spacious front yard
• Large cement patio
• Minutes from major shopping

A classic home with space, character, and a convenient setting — ready for its next chapter.
